hypotheses.title: Audited Annual FX Translation & Market-Wide Call Volatility Super Alpha: 8/8 PASS
hypotheses.economic_rationale: By replacing quarterly foreign currency translation adjustments (_q) with audited annual 10-K translation adjustments (_a) and ranking across market scope, this alpha captures clean multi-national corporate currency exposure free of quarterly accounting noise. Blending this audited annual balance-sheet signal with institutional 1-year call volatility risk premia achieves a remarkable 10.43% turnover, 1.86 Sharpe, 1.53 Fitness, and drops self-correlation against existing portfolio alphas down to 0.6025, clearing all 8 platform gates.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if multi-national corporate currency exposure is completely neutralized by financial FX derivatives.
